Commentary.Commentary: With dew coming into the picture during the run chase, the Indians will fancy the chase with the kind of batting lineup they have. The opening stand for them will be the key. Interesting to see how the Indians approach the run chase. Can they win the first game of their home season or will the visitors be able to make a winning start to the tour? Join us back for the run chase in a short while.

Temba Bavuma is down there for an interview with Shaun Pollock. He says that he is happy with his performance but wanted to do bit more for the team. Says that Quinton's innings helped him to settle down and the tour here with the A team helped him to acclimatize to the conditions. Further says that the pitch was a good one to bat on but got difficult as the ball started to stop on the surface.

For the hosts, Navdeep Saini (barring the last over), Deepak Chahar and Hardik Pandya were excellent in the final overs. In the spin department, Washington Sundar and Ravindra Jadeja made sure the run scoring was always under check.

Skipper Quinton de Kock along with Reeza Hendricks started the innings with a bang. The South African skipper looked on song from the start and raked up a top notch half century. He along with Bavuma added a crucial 57-run stand. The visitors were looking on track but the wicket of de Kock brought down the run rate and good smart bowling from the Indians strangled the run scoring.
A last over flourish would mean that South Africa has a decent total to defend. They were pushed back by the Indian bowlers during the middle overs but they would take this score after the crumble.

SIX! Bam! Another slower ball disappears over the fence. A very good finish for the South Africans. 16 runs from the over. A slower ball around middle and leg, Pretorius clears his front leg and wallops it into the mid-wicket fence. South Africa end with 149 runs on the board.
Fuller ball around off, Pretorius drives it through mid on and takes a quick couple. He takes Jadeja's arm on and makes it.
Full toss outside off, Phehlukwayo goes back to make room, he drills it through covers for a single this time.
SIX! Finally a six! Slower ball on middle, slightly shortish, Phehlukwayo reads it well this time and pulls it over the mid-wicket fence. A much needed six for the visitors.
Yorker this time. Pretorius can only jam it towards the third man region for a leg bye.
Good length ball outside off, Pretorius goes for the cut by shuffling towards the leg side but is beaten.
Navdeep Saini will bowl the last over. His figures read 3-0-19-1.

Nails the yorker this time, does Pandya. No room whatsoever for Pretorius to open his arms. Pretorius fails to jam it out and it goes off his pads. A leg bye picked. Excellent over from Hardik, just 4 runs and a wicket.
Another slower bouncer. Another attempted pull fails as Phehlukwayo is hit on the body again. The ball goes towards square leg for a single.
Banged one short around leg. Phehlukwayo goes to pull but can't get bat on ball. He inquired about the wide from the umpire but well, the umpire's call is final.
Length ball outside off, Pretorius drives it firmly but can't beat the mid off fielder. They get just a single.
Good length ball on middle, Phehlukwayo tucks it towards short third man and takes a single.
Andile Phehlukwayo replaces David Miller in the middle.

OUT! Pandya knocks Miller over. No Miller carnage then. A slower ball has done the trick for the Indians again. Miller is looking for quick runs as he goes for the wild slog. This is a slower one on middle, Miller goes for the slog but he has been beaten for pace. He goes too early into the shot and misses. The ball goes to shatter the woodwork behind.
Hardik Pandya is back into the attack!
A low full toss on the pads to finish the over. Miller flicks but will only get a single as he finds the deep mid-wicket fielder. Just 3 runs from this Saini over.
Superb from Chahar! Another slower bouncer. This is outside off and closer to off pole. Miller goes to cut but is deceived by the slowness of the ball.
Good length around off, drives through cover for a single.
Length ball around off, worked towards point for a single.
Another slower ball. Miller looks to pull but he is too early into the shot. He gets hit on the body.
Dwaine Pretorius is the next man in!

OUT! No half century for Bavuma as Jadeja takes a sitter at long on. A slower one deceives the batsman again. Bavuma mistimed a few shots in the last over as well and the pressure got better of him this time. This is a length ball outside off, Bavuma wants to drag it down the leg side and whip it over the mid-wicket fence. But he finds Jadeja at long on instead. A knock on the slower side by Temba.
Deepak Chahar is back into the attack.
Full toss on the pads, Bavuma mistimes the shot towards the leg side and can only get a single.
Fuller around off this time, Bavuma crunches it through the covers. The ball races towards the deep cover fence but Jadeja makes a diving stop and keeps it to two.
Full ball on middle, Bavuma goes for the paddle sweep but because off the slowness of the ball, he can't get the bat properly. The ball goes towards Pant on the bounce.
Nails the yorker this time! Bavuma can only jam his bat down in time and push the ball back to the bowler.
Full toss around off, Bavuma can't pierce the gap as he finds the cover fielder.
Good length ball on the pads,  Miller looks to work it on the leg side but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Saini is into the attack!
Full delivery on middle, Miller flicks it towards the leg side for a single.

SIX! Excellent shot from Miller here. Goes inside out to this floated delivery outside off and lofts this over the extra cover fence for a maximum. It is not easy to play these kind of shots and Miller has played this perfectly.
Flighted delivery on middle, Miller flicks this nicely towards the leg side for a couple. Excellent running this from the batters. Jadeja puts in a throw but is wayward.
Floated ball on middle, Bavuma comes down the track and flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short delivery on middle and leg, Miller flicks it to deep square leg and takes a single.
Fuller one around off, Bavuma works it towards mid on for a single.
Washington Sundar into the attack now! Just 7 off his 2 overs.
Good length ball around off, Bavuma drives it towards mid off for a single.
Slower bouncer this time, Miller goes back and pulls it to fine leg for a single this time.
On the pads, Bavuma flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
On the hips this time, tucked towards square leg for a run.
Just short of long on. A slower bouncer from Pandya. Bavuma hammers it to the long on region, on a bounce to the fielder.

Slightly fuller around off, Bavuma shuffles across the off stump to work it down the leg side but can't get bat on ball. He is hit on the pads. Miller at the non-striker wanted a run but was sent back. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but fails to hit the stumps.
Hardik Pandya is back into the attack! He started poorly with the ball. Can he make amends now?
Slightly short one on middle, worked towards mid-wicket for a single this time.
Fuller one on off, Bavuma works it towards mid-wicket with a gentle push and takes a quick couple. Great running between the wickets.
Short ball outside off, Bavuma goes back and cuts it through point for a couple.
On middle and leg, Miller tucks it towards square leg for a single.

Full delivery on off, Bavuma drives it to point and takes off for a single. Ravindra Jadeja runs in from point and throws it towards the bowler's end but misses. Had he hit, Bavuma would have been out. Even the dive would not have saved him there.
Starts with a short ball on off, Bavuma pushes it towards the off side.
Krunal Pandya is into the attack.
On off, Bavuma pushes it towards deep cover for a single.
Shortish ball around off, Miller opens the bat face and takes a single through third man.
Fuller ball on middle and leg, tucked towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Crunched! Flighted ball outside off, Bavuma drives it past diving Kohli at cover for a boundary. Top shot from Bavuma.
Fuller one on middle, Miller pushes it towards long on for a single.
David Miller is the new man in.

OUT! Another one bites the dust and Jadeja takes a superb catch on his follow-through. Jadeja bowls this quicker around middle, Rassie looks to work it down the leg side but gets a leading edge. The ball lobs to the right of Jadeja who takes the catch nicely.
Fuller one this time, Dussen drives it through covers for a single.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
Fuller around off this time, blocked towards point.
Fuller one this time, pushed towards mid on. Bavuma wanted a run but was sent back. A decent effort from the fielder would've been the end of Rassie.
Rassie van der Dussen is the new man in!

OUT! Indian skipper takes a stunner to send his counterpart packing. An absolute blinder from Kohli. Quinton de Kock was looking dangerous and India needed someone to do something special and who better than Kohli to do that. Saini bowls a back of a length ball, de Kock looks to pull but he is early into the shot and gets a top edge. The ball balloons high in the air towards mid off. Kohli runs to his left, gets closer to the ball and throws his hands to pluck it out of thin air. A great knock from QdK though.
Good length ball outside off, pushed towards mid off for a single.
Navdeep Saini is back into the attack.
Flighted one on middle, tucked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Shortish one this time, pulled towards long on for a single.

FOUR! Fifty as well for Quinton de Kock! Short delivery on middle, Quinton rocks back and pulls it towards the square leg region for a boundary. The fielder there dives to make the stop but is unable to stop the ball. Excellent innings from Quinton here. It has come in his first innings as captain.
Fuller ball, a flighted one. Bavuma drives it through the covers for a single.
Flatter one this time, worked towards long on for a single.
Fuller one on the pads, pushed towards long on for a single.
Fuller one around off, pushed towards long off for a single. Good over for the visitors.
FOUR! Another poor ball and Bavuma dispatches it. Another ball outside off on a shortish length. Bavuma goes back and cuts it again and the ball races to the deep point fence.
FOUR! Poor line and Bavuma punishes Pandya. Back of a length ball outside off, Bavuma stands tall and hammers the cut through cover-point for a boundary.
Fuller one around off, driven towards long off for a single.

Fumble from Iyer and they get an extra run and another one on overthrow. Good cricket from the two Proteas batters. Good length ball on the stumps, Bavuma drives it through point. It should have been just one but Iyer fumbles and allows an extra run. He then throws it to the bowler's end in a wayward manner. The ball goes towards mid-wicket allowing the batsmen to take another single. So what should have been a single, three runs have been taken.
Low full toss! A dipping one, de Kock blocks it towards long on for a run.
On the pads, tucked through square leg for a single.
FOUR! Short ball on middle, de Kock pulls it through the square leg fence. Moves to 44 with that boundary.
Flighted ball on middle, Bavuma comes down the track to work it through mid-wicket for a run.
On middle this time, QdK looks to reverse sweep but can't get bat on ball. The ball hits the pads and goes towards mid-wicket for a leg bye.
Fuller one on the pads, worked towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Shortish ball from Jadeja, QdK finds deep mid-wicket with his pull. Just a run.
Slower bouncer! Bavuma is deceived as he looks to play the upper cut and he is unable to get bat on ball.
SIX! Hammered! Pandya dishes this in the slot for Bavuma and he powers it over the deep square leg fence for a maximum. First six of the innings.
Another short ball down the leg side. QdK pulls it straight to fine leg for a single.
Shortish one this time, worked towards square leg for a run.
This would've been called wide down the leg side but QdK is shuffling towards the leg side. He gets an inside edge and the ball goes towards cover after hitting the pads. They get a run.
Pandya starts with a bumper outside off, Bavuma stands tall and pushes it through covers for a single.
Hardik Pandya is on now!
Quicker length ball, Bavuma works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller and a loopy ball, QdK drives it towards long on for a single.
Flighted one on middle, pushed through mid on for a single this time.
Darts one around middle and off, he goes back and works it towards square leg for a single.
A flighted ball on middle, Bavuma works it towards long on and takes a single.
Shortish ball outside off, cut through covers for a single.
Ravindra Jadeja comes into the attack.

Good length ball on middle, this time Bavuma finds Dhawan at mid-wicket who has a shy at the non-striker's end thinking he might have ventured out for the run. He misses. 39 runs have come off the PowerPlay.
Slower ball on middle, de Kock looks to heave it but mistimes it towards mid on for a single.
Fuller again, QdK slices it towards point where Dhawan does well to stop with a tumble.
FOUR! Glorious! Overpitched this time and Quinton will not miss out. He gets into position and creams the cover drive for another boundary.
Length ball outside off, QdK makes room by shuffling towards the leg side and goes for the cut but gets a bottom edge and the ball goes towards Pant behind the wicket.

In the air... but Kohli can't get there. Chahar bangs it on middle. QdK is rushed into the pull shot as he mistimes it towards long on. The ball goes high but evades the running effort of the Indian skipper. They pick a couple.

A good finish to the over. This is a flighted ball which draws Bavuma into the drive but the ball takes the outside edge and goes to short third man all along the ground. Excellent over from Sundar here as he gave away just a single.
Shortish one on middle, tucked for a single towards mid-wicket.
Fuller one, almost yorked himself did de Kock. He wanted to go aerial but mistimed the shot onto his pads.
Flatter one outside off, QdK cuts but straight to the point fielder.
Loopy ball on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Darted one on middle, pushed towards mid off, Sundar hares and keeps the left-hander on strike.
Washington Sundar is back into the attack.
Good length ball outside off, blocked towards point by Bavuma.
Temba Bavuma replaces Reeza Hendricks out in the middle. He is on debut and will be looking to make an impact here.

OUT! First one! Reeza Hendrics departs as he finds Washington Sundar at mid on with his mistimed shot. This is fuller on middle, Hendricks looks to lift it over the mid on fielder but mistimes it straight to Sundar who takes a dolly. The bat turned in his hands while he looked to play that shot. The threatening opening stand is broken.
Poor ball but QdK finds the fielder. But a misfield from Pandya at cover means they get a run. This one is outside off on a length but de Kock can't find the gap.
Good length ball on middle, pushed towards mid-wicket gently and hared for a quick single.
On the pads this time, pushed towards mid-wicket for a single. They were looking for a couple but decided against it.

FOUR! QdK in some mood! He bags his fifth boundary in no time. Chahar starts the fresh over with a good length ball but outside off, de Kock cuts it between cover-point and through to the deep cover fence.

A good ball to end the over. Good length ball outside off, Hendricks goes for the cut but is beaten by the inswing. A good ball to end the over from Saini but a good over for South Africa as thirteen runs have come off it.
Shortish ball around off, de Kock taps it towards third man for a single.
Fuller around off this time, de Kock drives again but straight to cover.

FOUR! And another one. Superb shot. This is on the pads, de Kock this time flicks it through mid-wicket for another boundary. This outfield is very quick and once it crosses the inner circle, there is no way the ball can be stopped.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for de Kock. This one is a superb shot through the covers from de Kock. It is overpitched outside off, de Kock leans into the drive and creams it to the fence.

EDGY FOUR! Saini dishes a fullish ball on off, de Kock goes with the drive and gets an outside edge. There is only one slip and the ball goes through the second slip positon and into the third man fence.
Navdeep Saini is into the attack now.
Slightly fuller outside off, Hendricks strokes it straight to mid off. Just five from the over, a good start from Chahar.
Gets the line right and beats the bat this time. Outside off, Hendricks pokes his bat but the away movement means he can't get bat on ball.
FOUR! Easy picking that one! First boundary for Hendricks. On the pads from Chahar, Hendricks just helps it through to the square leg fence for a boundary.
Beaten! In the channel this time from Chahar. Hendricks looks to block by playing in the line but the ball shapes away from the bat and goes to Pant behind the wicket.
Fuller one on middle and leg, it goes towards cover off the outer half of the bat. Some swing on offer for Chahar.
Good length ball outside off, pushed towards cover for a single.
Deepak Chahar will bowl from the other end.
Another one on the pads, tucked straight to square leg. A decent start from Sundar.
Fuller on off, de Kock taps it towards mid off for a single.
A short one outside off this time, can't find the gap through the covers this time.
FOUR! Off the mark with a crunching four! This was outside off, enough room for De Kock to flex his muscles. He smacks it through to  the cover fence for a boundary.
First runs! On the pads, a flighted one, tucked towards square leg for a single.
He starts on middle and leg, Hendricks pushes it towards mid-wicket.

We are all set to begin! Quinton de Kock and Reeza Hendricks make their way out to the middle along with the Indian players. Spin first up as Washington Sundar is ready to bowl. Reeza Hendricks will be on strike.
Both the teams make their way out to the ground for their respective National Anthems. First up will be the National Anthem of the visitors and then for the home team.

South Africa (Playing XI) - Quinton de Kock (C/WK), Reeza Hendricks, Temba Bavuma (DEBUT), Rassie van der Dussen, David Miller, Andile Phehlukwayo, Dwaine Pretorius, Bjorn Fortuin (DEBUT), Kagiso Rabada, Anrich Nortje (DEBUT), Tabraiz Shamsi
India (Playing XI) -  Rohit Sharma, Shikhar Dhawan, Virat Kohli(C), Shreyas Iyer, Rishabh Pant(WK), Hardik Pandya, Krunal Pandya, Ravindra Jadeja, Washington Sundar, Deepak Chahar, Navdeep Saini

Quinton de Kock starts by saying he is enjoying the captaincy responsibility. De Kock says that the senior members like him, Miller and Rabada keep sharing whatever they have learned over the years with the youngsters. Adds that while the side is full of the youngsters, they will be very competitive. Confirms that they have three debutants in the side.

Kohli says that the surface is hard and looking good to bat. He feels that the dew can come into play later in the second innings. Adds that Mohali being a chasing ground is one of the reasons why he is opting to bowl first. On reminded about the T20 match against Australia during World T20 in 2016, Kohli says that he remembers it well and it  was one of the best matches he has been part of. Kohli reveals that Manish Pandey, KL Rahul, Khaleel Ahmed and Rahul Chahar are the players who miss out.
Toss - The home captain Virat Kohli flips the coin and his counterpart Quinton de Kock has called the wrong side. Kohli opts to chase the target.

After a no show at Dharamshala because of the rain, the T20 caravan has arrived in Mohali where the weather looks pretty good and we will be having some show from both the sides. The Men in Blue look far superior in the batting department. However, they have gone for a lesser experienced bowling unit as they have rested the likes of Jasprit Bumrah and Bhuvneshwar Kumar. With the T20 World Cup in sight, they have quite a few games to test their strengths in the bowling department. The visitors, on the other hand, have a new skipper Quinton de Kock leading a fairly young side. Along with the skipper, the Proteas will be highly relying on David Miller and Kagiso Rabada's experience. Interestingly, the Proteas have never lost a T20I game against the Men in Blue in India and they would look at that record going into the match. The hosts, on the other hand, would count on their experience and would believe that they can edge out the visitors to start their home season on a winning note. Welcome to our coverage of the 2nd T20I of the 3-match series. Pitch and Toss update in a while. Stay tuned...
